title: Radio: Crew 4 — Northgate Reservoir Gate Valve Leak

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is Crew 4 on Route 33. We're at the Northgate Reservoir and found the gate valve on the 12-inch line cracked — it's dripping. No pressure loss, but the water is pooling near the valve house. We've secured the area and are waiting for your go-ahead on whether to shut it down or let it run until a repair crew arrives. The HMI shows normal levels, but the field has a 3-inch puddle.

Crew 4, confirm: no pressure loss, no drop in reservoir level, and the HMI for LIT-301 shows 1,018 feet — within normal band. Do not isolate the line. Monitor the puddle and report any increase in volume or change in pressure within 30 minutes. We are not at risk of a loss of containment at this time.
Copy, Control. We’re standing by, monitoring the puddle. No change in pressure. The leak is steady but not worsening. We’ll report if it does.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, calm, steady, with a hint of caution

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging, as the HMI data matches the field observation and no system risk is present.
